alerts.title: Iran war live: Trump says war ‘effectively over’, Iran demands ‘surrender’
alerts.why: Trump's claim that the war is effectively over eases Middle East risk premiums, removing fear-based support and weighing heavily on crude prices.

alerts.title: Trump signals ‘positive momentum’ with Iran after meeting Qatari PM
alerts.why: Ceasefire momentum regarding Iran reduces geopolitical risk premium, weighing on crude oil prices.

alerts.title: Saudi Arabia Confirms Strike on East-West Pipeline
alerts.why: Strike on Saudi critical infrastructure threatens major crude export volumes, triggering immediate risk premium.

alerts.title: Saudi Arabia downs missiles fired at Riyadh after Houthi attack on pipeline
alerts.why: Geopolitical supply threat targeting Saudi capital and pipeline infrastructure directly raises Middle East risk premium for crude oil.

alerts.title: Oil Prices Plunge Below $92 as Trump Signals Restraint on Iran
alerts.why: Geopolitical risk premium evaporates as Trump signals restraint on Iran, easing supply disruption fears and sending crude down sharply.

itemsSent.title: When can central bankers look through an oil shock?
itemsSent.why: Fed research suggesting higher sensitivity to oil prices implies a hawkish bias, potentially dampening long-term demand growth expectations.

itemsSent.title: Global LNG Markets Face a Winter of Extreme Uncertainty
itemsSent.why: Low European inventories and high price volatility create a bullish bias for natural gas, though weather and supply recovery remain significant downside risks.

itemsSent.title: Saudi Pipeline Attacked as OPEC Output Climbs to 90% of Pre-War Levels
itemsSent.why: Geopolitical risk premium increases due to pipeline attack, despite minimal operational damage and rising OPEC production levels.

itemsSent.title: Qatar PM meets with Trump for talks on ending war on Iran
itemsSent.why: Diplomatic talks to de-escalate tensions with Iran reduce geopolitical risk premium, weighing on crude oil prices.

itemsSent.title: China wholesale inflation hits highest in more than four years as consumer measure slows
itemsSent.why: Higher Chinese raw materials inflation boosts industrial costs, but slowing consumer inflation points to weak domestic demand, creating divergent pressures.

itemsSent.title: US Wholesale Inventories Growth Beats Estimates
itemsSent.why: Wholesale inventory growth signals economic activity, but higher petroleum stocks are bearish crude while supporting refined products.
